{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the 'status' column to understand the categories
status_counts = sales_df['status'].value_counts()
status_counts

# Check the revenue column for any non-numeric values or anomalies
revenue_sample = sales_df['revenue'].sample(10)
revenue_sample

# Convert revenue to float, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any invalid revenue values after conversion
invalid_revenue = sales_df[sales_df['revenue'].isnull()]
invalid_revenue_count = len(invalid_revenue)
invalid_revenue_count"}
